name: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang
short_description: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang is a verified Full/Half/10K/5K coastal marathon in Nha Trang, Vietnam, confirmed for 9 August 2026 with the highest confidence score in this directory.
ai_summary: VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang 2026 is a coastal marathon in Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, organized by VnExpress and FPT Online, confirmed for 9 August 2026. It offers Full Marathon, Half Marathon, 10km, and 5km distances, with registration open at 440,000 VND and a stated deadline of 30 July 2026. It carries the highest confidence score (93) of any race in this directory, verified directly against the official event website as of 13 July 2026.
pros: Highest confidence score (93) of any race currently verified in this directory

cons: Stated registration deadline (30 July 2026) is close relative to this listing's verification date, so it may have already passed depending on when you're reading this

research_highlights: Course runs along Nha Trang's iconic Tran Phu and Pham Van Dong coastal roads with sunrise starts (full marathon typically starts around 3am), plus a climb over Luong Son Pass (roughly up to 60m elevation) that is the main challenge for the 21km and 42km distances.
For 2025 the route was shortened on the pass section (about a 7km climb instead of ~10km previously) and the half marathon no longer includes the pass, with a finish near Quang Truong 2/4 square.
The event has grown steadily — from about 8,500 runners at its 2022 debut to roughly 13,000 in 2025 — and is run as a multi-day 'race-cation' weekend with an expo, race-kit pickup and side events.

Race-day weather is described as generally hot for Vietnam summer (organizers and past coverage cite temperatures commonly in the high-20s to low-30s °C around race time, though some editions reported cooler, even rainy conditions).

Aid stations, medical points and toilets are placed at regular intervals along the course, with extra lighting installed on newer sections (e.g., through the Libera Nha Trang urban area) for nighttime running.
research_watchouts: Heat and humidity are a recurring theme — organizer and news coverage repeatedly warn that many runners lose pace or drop out around km 25-30 due to heat-related fatigue rather than lack of fitness.

The Luong Son Pass climb is consistently flagged by runners and elites as the toughest technical/physical section, requiring extra hydration/electrolyte planning and shoe choice with more cushioning and grip for the descent.
Course details change from year to year (route length on the pass, finish area, start location), so runners should check the current year's official map rather than assume it matches a prior edition.
BIBs are not sent in advance for the 2026 edition — runners must collect their bib number in person at race-kit pickup rather than receiving it by email beforehand.

faqs.question: When is the VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang, and when does registration close?
faqs.answer: The race is confirmed for 9 August 2026 in Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa. Registration is open now at 440,000 VND per the official site, with a stated deadline of 30 July 2026 -- check the organizer's page directly if you're reading this after that date, since deadlines can be extended or entries can sell out.

faqs.question: Who organizes the VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang?
faqs.answer: The race is organized by VnExpress, a major Vietnamese news outlet, together with FPT Online. This gives the event stronger operational backing than many independently-run races, reflected in its confidence score of 93, the highest of any race currently verified in this directory.

faqs.question: What distances does the VnExpress Marathon Nha Trang offer?
faqs.answer: Four distances are available: a Full Marathon, a Half Marathon, a 10km, and a 5km, all starting in the coastal city of Nha Trang. This spread lets everything from first-time 5km runners to full-marathon veterans take part in the same race weekend.
